info.title: Teslatlas Hub public protocol
info.description: Implementation-neutral query, event, command, and metadata boundary.

200.description: UTF-8 SSE stream. Each data value is a v1 event envelope; cross-field equality is enforced by conformance semantics.

202.description: Command accepted for asynchronous authorisation and execution.

get.summary: Get a metadata record or deletion tombstone

bearerAuth.description: Credential acquisition and rotation are deployment concerns; never place a token in discovery or fixtures.

ETag.description: Opaque validator for the selected representation.

StrongETag.description: Opaque strong validator for a mutable metadata revision.

ProtocolVersion.description: Protocol version selected for this response.

Vary.description: Request fields that select the representation.

Location.description: URI of the created asynchronous job or metadata record.

ProtocolVersion.name: Teslatlas-Protocol-Version
ProtocolVersion.description: Highest protocol version understood by the client. Omission requests the minimum supported version in discovery.

IfNoneMatch.name: If-None-Match
IfNoneMatch.description: Opaque cached ETag; GET uses weak comparison.

IfMatch.name: If-Match
IfMatch.description: Strong ETag of the metadata revision being replaced or deleted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: UUID retained for at least the advertised idempotency window.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque continuation token. Never decode or edit it.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Opaque SSE event ID after which replay resumes.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem detail with a stable Teslatlas code.

StrongNotModified.description: The selected mutable metadata representation matches If-None-Match.

MetadataEntity.description: Live metadata record or persistent deletion tombstone.

confirmation.description: Required when the discovered command descriptor sets confirmation_required to true.

Event.title: Teslatlas v1 SSE data envelope
Event.$comment: JSON Schema validates structure and event-to-payload type. Cross-field identity equality is a required semantic rule enforced by the conformance runner.
